tasks.label: Task: ros2_control
args: source /ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch ur_robotiq control_bimanual_ur_mia.launch.py use_cartesian_stitcher:=true left_robot_ip:=192.168.1.4 right_robot_ip:=192.168.1.5 right_mia_port:=/dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_TTL-232R-3V3-AJ_FTGRD1P9-if00-port0 left_mia_port:=/dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_TTL-232R-3V3-AJ_FTBWH3EC-if00-port0 mode:=none

tasks.label: Task: ros2_mia_left
args: source /ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch mia_hand_ros2_control mia_hand_system_interface_launch.py serial_port:=/dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_TTL-232R-3V3-AJ_FTBWH3EC-if00-port0 controller:=group_pos_trajectory_controller joint_limits_config_file:='/ws/src/ur_robotiq/config/left_hand_joint_limits.yaml' transmission_config_file:='/ws/src/ur_robotiq/config/left_hand_transmission.yaml' rqt_joint_trajectory_controller_gui:=true

tasks.label: Task: ros2_mia_right
args: source /ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch mia_hand_ros2_control mia_hand_system_interface_launch.py serial_port:=/dev/serial/by-id/usb-FTDI_TTL-232R-3V3-AJ_FTGRD1P9-if00-port0 controller:=group_pos_trajectory_controller joint_limits_config_file:='/ws/src/ur_robotiq/config/right_hand_joint_limits.yaml' transmission_config_file:='/ws/src/ur_robotiq/config/right_hand_transmission.yaml' rqt_joint_trajectory_controller_gui:=true
